text:
mina: Kicking off v2.7.0 deploy to ap-south with a feature-flagged routing change. Window 01:30-02:30 IST. We'll do a split-cohort flow with a manual gate at the regional ramp. @deploy-bot please enqueue.

deploy-bot: Job D-110334 scheduled by mina for 01:30 IST. Ramp outline: 2% -> 12% -> manual-approval -> 35% -> 70% -> 100%. Holds 6m except final monitor 20m. Telemetry tags will be attached.

raj: Manual gate? who signs off at that stage?

mina: courtney owns manual approval after cohort=pilot-group. She's on-call. If courtney doesn't ack in 4m we auto-rollback.

courtney: ack. I'll check QA smoke and infra traces during the gate.

ops-bot: Muting noisy alerts "ops-chatter" for 60m from 01:25 IST. SEV1 still propagated.

mina: Rollback triggers: 5m error rate >1.7x baseline OR p95 latency >380ms OR user 5xx >=0.6% OR token throughput >2x forecast. On rollback: `deploy-bot abort D-110334 && scripts/pin_version.sh router v2.6.9 && scripts/disable_flag.sh routing_experimental`

infra-bot: Note: we'll reduce cache TTL to 20s during regional ramp to avoid KV drift. Use `scripts/kv_check.sh <region>` post-flip.

deploy-bot: Executing step 1 in 30s: `scripts/rollout_toggle.sh routing_experimental pilot-group true` (2%).

deploy-bot: Step 1 complete @01:30:18 - pilot-group (2%). tags: D-110334 step=1 cohort=pilot-group

raj: +4m: pilot metrics look fine. p50 +4ms, errors steady. moving to step 2.

deploy-bot: Step 2 started @01:37:05 - cohort=early-beta (12%). Holding 6m.

mina: Reminder: after step 2 we STOP and wait for courtney's manual approval before regional ramp. Do not proceed automatically.

courtney: Running smoke tests now. Quick checklist: happy-requests ok, auth path exercised, billing delta negligible.

support-bot: Posting release blurb to #support: "v2.7.0: routing + batching improvements; staged enable of routing_experimental by cohort. Rollback criteria in eng-releases."

courtney: Smoke pass. infra traces clear. I approve proceed -> regional_ramp.

mina: courtney approved. proceeding to regional ramp. ops-bot keep an eye on token throughput.

ops-bot: Watching token throughput and autoscale events. Will alert if >1.8x predicted.

deploy-bot: Executing step 3 @01:50:00 - cohort=ap-south-region (35%). Cache TTL lowered to 20s per infra-bot. tags: D-110334 step=3 cohort=ap-south-region

raj: +3m into step 3: p95 spiked to 320ms for 90s then recovered. No increase in 5xx. continue hold.

mina: Good note. If p95 crosses 400ms sustain for 3m we rollback. Also, if a single shard looks bad we can exclude it with `flags.exclude_shards=<shard-id>` instead of full backout.

infra-bot: Running `scripts/kv_check.sh ap-south-region` now - no KV mismatches.

deploy-bot: Step 3 hold complete. Starting step 4 -> 70% @01:59:30.

raj: During step 4 we saw a surge in token usage on shard s-17. ops-bot - did autoscale kick?

ops-bot: Autoscale triggered +1 node on s-17 at 02:00:20. Token throughput returned to expected range. No abort.

mina: proceeding to full enable after 6m hold if metrics steady. Final monitor 20m after 100%.

deploy-bot: Step 5 full enable @02:06:02 - routing_experimental = true for 100%. tags: D-110334 step=5 cohort=all

mina: Final monitor started. Team please post +5m and +15m status.

raj: +5m final-check: p50/p95 stable, errors normal. No customer impact seen.

courtney: +15m final-check: looks green. I'll update release notes with customer-facing summary.

mina: Thanks all. Closing thread. If any late regressions, reopen or file incident. :white_check_mark:

(End of thread)
